system.description: Take the option below that matches your favored enemy. Apply this effect always (not just against your Favored Enemy). Beasts: Add 50ft to the range of all ranged weapons. Great Beast: You cannot be Surrounded. Awoken Flora: Gain 1X advantage to all trait checks made against Pin. Folk Fae: Gain damage resistance equal to half your Wiles Score (rounded up). Wild Fae: When you attack an enemy who is Surprised, gain 1X advantage to your attack. Fontmade: Choose 1 element (Rot, Salt, Earth, Fire, Air, Water); gain resistance to this damage type equal to your Proficiency. Undead: You cannot be given Nausea by any means. Demon: When you are critically hit, use your reaction to turn that critical to-hit into a normal hit (or a miss if you have Steadied).
